questions.question: What does AI stand for?
questions.explanation: AI stands for Artificial Intelligence — the simulation of human intelligence by machines.

questions.question: What is the main goal of Artificial Intelligence?
options: To create machines that can perform tasks requiring human intelligence
questions.explanation: The core goal of AI is to develop systems that can reason, learn, perceive, and act in ways that typically require human intelligence.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of Narrow AI?
options: A system that can do any intellectual task a human can do
A robot that can cook any meal and drive a car
questions.explanation: Narrow AI (Weak AI) is designed for specific tasks, like language translation or image recognition. ChatGPT is a good example.

questions.question: What is Machine Learning?
options: Programming rules manually for every situation
A subset of AI where systems learn patterns from data instead of being explicitly programmed
questions.explanation: Machine Learning is a branch of AI that enables computers to learn and improve from experience (data) without being explicitly programmed for every rule.

questions.question: What does 'training a model' mean in AI?
options: Teaching the model by showing it examples so it can make predictions
questions.explanation: During training, an AI model learns patterns from a dataset by adjusting its internal parameters (weights) to minimize errors.

questions.question: Which of these is a common application of AI today?
options: Recommendation systems on Netflix and YouTube
questions.explanation: Recommendation engines (used by Netflix, Amazon, YouTube, etc.) are one of the most successful real-world applications of AI.

questions.question: What is a Neural Network inspired by?
options: The structure of the human brain
questions.explanation: Artificial Neural Networks are inspired by the biological neural networks in the human brain, consisting of interconnected nodes (neurons).

questions.question: What is the role of data in AI?
options: It is the fuel — AI models learn patterns from large amounts of data
It is only used for testing
questions.explanation: High-quality, large volumes of data are essential for training effective AI models. 'Garbage in, garbage out' applies strongly in AI.
